title: ProcessPoolExecutor.shutdown(wait=True) deadlocks when worker exit messages fill the result pipe
author: tfzee
body_preview: ### Bug report  `ProcessPoolExecutor.shutdown(wait=True)` can hang forever when the pool has many workers.
